skill_name: Select two movies that are similar to each other and summarize the similarities.
workflow: The Godfather (1972) and The Irishman (2019) are similar in many ways. The Godfather follows the story of Don Vito Corleone and Michael Corleone, and The Irishman follows the story of Frank Sheeran.
